text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers (`BoundKeyValue`, `PassesKeyValueGate`, `HasPurposeWord`, `IsLookupKey`, `KeySecretType`) keep the original conditions, short-circuit order and `value.Trim()` handling, and removing the nested ternary, the long `||` chain and the inline switch should bring the method under 15. I couldn't build it here, so the one open risk is that `PassesKeyValueGate` takes `string[] lines`, which compiles only if `lines` is a `string[]` in the caller.
